tools.name: freshlearn_list_members
tools.description: List and search members, newest first. Filter by exact email, free text, source or creation time. Cursor-paginated: pass pageInfo.nextCursor back as cursor. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/members.

tools.name: freshlearn_get_member
tools.description: Retrieve one member by ID. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/members/{id}.

tools.name: freshlearn_count_members
tools.description: Count members that match the same filters as freshlearn_list_members. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/members/count.

tools.name: freshlearn_list_course_enrollments
tools.description: List course enrollments, newest first. Filter by member email, course, pricing plan or enrollment time. Cursor-paginated. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/course-enrollments.

tools.name: freshlearn_get_course_enrollment
tools.description: Retrieve one course enrollment by ID. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/course-enrollments/{id}.

tools.name: freshlearn_list_course_completions
tools.description: List members who completed a course (completion of 100% or more), most recent first. Cursor-paginated. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/course-completions.

tools.name: freshlearn_get_course_structure
tools.description: Return a course's structure: modules and chapters. Only enabled modules and published chapters are returned. FreshLearn: GET /v1/integration/course/{courseId}/structure.

tools.name: freshlearn_list_product_enrollments
tools.description: List enrollments for one product type (bundle, digital download or masterclass), newest first. The type is required. Cursor-paginated. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/product-enrollments.

tools.name: freshlearn_list_payments
tools.description: List and search payments, newest first. Filter by member email, status, payment platform, amount or time. Cursor-paginated. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/payments.

tools.name: freshlearn_get_payment
tools.description: Retrieve one payment by ID. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/payments/{id}.

tools.name: freshlearn_list_assessment_results
tools.description: List assessment attempts, newest first: member, course, score and pass/fail, with per-question results. Cursor-paginated. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/assessment-results.

tools.name: freshlearn_create_member
tools.description: Create a new member in the FreshLearn account. email, fullName and source are required. Creates a real member record. FreshLearn: POST /v1/integration/member.

tools.name: freshlearn_update_member
tools.description: Update an existing member, matched by email. The email itself cannot change. fullName and source are required. Setting the same values again has no further effect. FreshLearn: PUT /v1/integration/member.

tools.name: freshlearn_enroll_member_in_course
tools.description: Enroll an existing member in a course with a payment record. courseId, planId, memberEmail, transactionId and source are required. Grants course access. FreshLearn: POST /v1/integration/member/enroll.

tools.name: freshlearn_unenroll_member_from_course
tools.description: Remove a member's enrollment from a course, which removes their access. If the member is not enrolled, nothing changes. FreshLearn: POST /v1/integration/member/unenroll/course.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: freshlearn_list_members, freshlearn_list_course_enrollments, freshlearn_list_payments · Private data: freshlearn_create_member, freshlearn_enroll_member_in_course · Public sink: freshlearn_list_members, freshlearn_list_course_enrollments, freshlearn_list_payments, freshlearn_create_member, freshlearn_update_member, freshlearn_enroll_member_in_course, freshlearn_unenroll_member_from_course · Destructive: freshlearn_unenroll_member_from_course.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: freshlearn_list_members, freshlearn_list_course_enrollments, freshlearn_list_payments · Private data: freshlearn_create_member, freshlearn_enroll_member_in_course · Public sink: freshlearn_list_members, freshlearn_list_course_enrollments, freshlearn_list_payments, freshlearn_create_member, freshlearn_update_member, freshlearn_enroll_member_in_course, freshlearn_unenroll_member_from_course · Destructive: freshlearn_unenroll_member_from_course

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
